title: Shared definitions
description: The formats the other schemas share, referenced from them as definitions.schema.json#/definitions/<name>. scripts/validate.ts explains a value that fails one of them by that name.

id.description: Lowercase ASCII letters and digits, words joined by single hyphens.

url.description: A web address, http:// or https://: it is published as a link.

wikipedia.description: An article of the English Wikipedia, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/<title>, as its address bar shows it: the article's own title rather than a redirect to it, and no #section.
